title: DeckCraft railing colours: manufacturer sources
approved: 2026-09-23: the owner approved this list for the railing colour control and chose to ship all 19 systems. The 8 lines marked canada "unconfirmed" carry a flag asking the supplier to confirm availability and any colour premium.
method: Colour names were read from the manufacturer product pages on timbertech.com and deckorators.com, fetched on 2026-09-23. They were cross-checked against TimberTech's official product feed (shop.timbertech.com/wp-content/cache/products/*.json, the same data the product-page swatch picker loads), the TimberTech 2026 Product Guide PDF, and the Deckorators Shopify product JSON and sell-sheet PDFs. screenHex with hexSource 'swatch' is the per-channel median of the centre 60% of the manufacturer's own swatch image. It is for on-screen preview only and is not colour-accurate.
use: railColours are the colours the railing colour control offers (deckPartFinishes.ts RAILING_COLOURS must match them, name and screen hex; scripts/check-deck-part-finishes.ts checks it). infillColours are recorded for reference; the preview draws the infill in the rail colour. screenHex is a screen approximation for the illustrative 3D preview only, never a colour match. The railing rate is unchanged by a colour.

systems.notes: Rail, post sleeve, cap and skirt colours: White (gloss), Matte White, Matte Black, Matte Espresso. Trademark Rail top rail comes only in White and Matte White. Premier and Radiance top rails come in 10' only in White, Matte White and Matte Black. Matte colours carry an extra 25-year Fade & Stain warranty. Canada: timbertech.ca/products/railing/classiccomposite shows swatches Matte Black, Matte Espresso, Matte White, Black and White. The extra gloss 'Black' is not on timbertech.com or in the 2026 Product Guide and is probably stale (the .ca site is (c) 2018-2023). The .ca page also says limited products may be special-order with extended lead times.
